### NEW DATA LOAD

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. LOAD & CLEAN WEATHER DATA
weather <- read.csv("data/Weather Data_Avangrid_Hackathon (Sheet1).csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)

weather_clean <- weather |>
  mutate(
    usage_date  = format(as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
    hour_ending = as.integer(sub(":.*", "", as.character(time))) + 1L,
    temp        = as.numeric(temp),
    humidity    = as.numeric(humidity),
    windspeed   = as.numeric(windspeed)
  ) |>
  select(usage_date, hour_ending, temp, humidity, windspeed) |>
  distinct(usage_date, hour_ending, .keep_all = TRUE)

weather_arrow <- as_arrow_table(weather_clean)


# 2. CONVERT ALL 4 CSV FOLDERS + MERGE WEATHER -> FINAL PARQUETS (cache_clean)
folders <- c(
  "data/2026 Avangrid Hackathon Data_1_10000",
  "data/2026 Avangrid Hackathon Data_10001_20000_v2",
  "data/2026 Avangrid Hackathon Data_20001_30000",
  "data/2026 Avangrid Hackathon Data_30001_35725"
)

out_dir  <- "cache_clean"
log_file <- file.path(out_dir, "load_log.txt")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

t0 <- Sys.time()
trace <- function(...) {
  msg <- sprintf("[%s | %5.1f min] %s", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"),
                 as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")), sprintf(...))
  cat(msg, "\n"); cat(msg, "\n", file = log_file, append = TRUE); flush.console()
}

files <- unlist(lapply(folders, list.files, pattern = "\\.csv$",
                       full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE))
stopifnot("No CSV files found—check folder paths." = length(files) > 0)

sizes <- file.size(files)
trace("Found %d CSVs, %.2f GB total, median %.1f KB",
      length(files), sum(sizes) / 1e9, median(sizes) / 1e3)

nms <- names(open_csv_dataset(files[1]))
sch <- schema(setNames(rep(list(utf8()), length(nms)), nms))

done_bytes <- 0; total_bytes <- sum(sizes)
t_start <- Sys.time()

for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  marker <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("file_%04d.done", i))
  if (file.exists(marker)) { done_bytes <- done_bytes + sizes[i]; next }

  ok <- tryCatch({
    open_csv_dataset(files[i], schema = sch, skip = 1) |>
      mutate(hour_ending = as.integer(hour_ending)) |>
      left_join(weather_arrow, by = c("usage_date", "hour_ending")) |>
      write_dataset(
        out_dir,
        format = "parquet",
        compression = "zstd",
        basename_template = sprintf("file_%04d-{i}.parquet", i)
      )
    file.create(marker); TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    trace("File %d FAILED (%s): %s", i, basename(files[i]), conditionMessage(e))
    FALSE
  })

  done_bytes <- done_bytes + sizes[i]
  rate <- done_bytes / as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "secs"))
  trace("File %d/%d %s | %.1f%% | ETA %.1f min", i, length(files),
        if (ok) "ok" else "FAILED", 100 * done_bytes / total_bytes,
        (total_bytes - done_bytes) / rate / 60)
}

# 3. LOAD FINAL DATASET & VERIFY CUSTOMERS + COLUMNS
pq <- list.files("cache_clean", pattern = "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE)
ds <- open_dataset(pq, format = "parquet")
trace("Dataset ready: %d rows x %d cols", nrow(ds), ncol(ds))

head(ds) |> collect()

cust_counts <- ds |>
  count(CUSTOMER_NUMBER) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(CUSTOMER_NUMBER = as.numeric(CUSTOMER_NUMBER)) |>
  arrange(CUSTOMER_NUMBER)

nrow(cust_counts)          # Total distinct customers (should be ~35,725)
summary(cust_counts$n)     # Distribution of hourly rows per customer
head(cust_counts, 10)
tail(cust_counts, 10)


# 4. BUILD & SAVE DAILY SUMMARY (data/daily.rds)
daily <- ds |>
  filter(is_complete_hour == "1") |>
  mutate(kwh = as.numeric(hourly_kwh)) |>
  group_by(usage_date) |>
  summarise(total_kwh = sum(kwh, na.rm = TRUE), n_rows = n()) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(usage_date),
    avg_kwh_per_customer_hour = total_kwh / n_rows,
    approx_customers = n_rows / 24
  ) |>
  arrange(date)

dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(daily, "data/daily.rds")

# Sanity checks
sum(is.na(daily$date))     # want 0
range(daily$date)          # want 2025-09-01 to ~2026-08-31
nrow(daily)                # want ~365
daily |> arrange(n_rows) |> head(10)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

# 1. Exact vector of missing customer numbers from 1 to 35,725
missing_ids <- setdiff(1:35725, cust_counts$CUSTOMER_NUMBER)
length(missing_ids)
head(missing_ids, 50)

# 2. Group consecutive missing IDs into contiguous ranges (start_id to end_id)
missing_ranges <- tibble(id = missing_ids) |>
  mutate(gap_group = cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(id) > 1))) |>
  group_by(gap_group) |>
  summarise(
    start_id  = min(id),
    end_id    = max(id),
    n_missing = n(),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) |>
  select(-gap_group)

# Largest contiguous gaps first (a block of 100–1,000+ indicates a missing CSV batch)
missing_ranges |>
  arrange(desc(n_missing)) |>
  print(n = 30)

# 3. Missing count broken down by the 4 folder ranges
tibble(id = 1:35725) |>
  mutate(
    present = id %in% cust_counts$CUSTOMER_NUMBER,
    folder_bucket = case_when(
      id <= 10000 ~ "1_10000",
      id <= 20000 ~ "10001_20000_v2",
      id <= 30000 ~ "20001_30000",
      TRUE        ~ "30001_35725"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(folder_bucket) |>
  summarise(
    expected = n(),
    present  = sum(present),
    missing  = sum(!present),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

# 4. Sanity check: any IDs in ds that are NA or outside 1:35725?
cust_counts |>
  filter(is.na(CUSTOMER_NUMBER) | !CUSTOMER_NUMBER %in% 1:35725)

```
